reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 40 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text: My staff is attempting to get whatever information they can regarding the nationwide ground stop. The one thing that we've ascertained is that this will not be resolved quickly. As soon as we have information that we can share, we will.

Trump’s Big Ugly Bill already cut more than 5 million people off SNAP. Now his administration wants to take it away from another 6 million.

SNAP only gives folks $6 a day to eat. So while they’re standing in the grocery aisle doing the math, Trump’s got his mind on his ballroom, https://t.co/FLocXkuday

Wishing my friend, @RepLouCorrea, strength, healing, and a smooth recovery. 

We need you healthy and back to doing what you do best.

Keeping you in my thoughts and prayers!

Happy Veterans Day to America’s bravest.

Thank you for your service, your strength, and all you’ve given and sacrificed for this country. 

We’re proud to call you our nation’s heroes.

Hegseth has a track record of leading an illegal and unconstitutional war that has cost innocent lives, disrespecting women service members, and spending over $8.9 million of your taxpayer dollars on crab and lobster.

This is not a reality show.

Impeach Peter Brian Hegseth.

Trump will reward just about anybody willing to do his dirty work.

Promoting someone so barbaric, cruel, and reckless is another pathetic attempt to protect his corrupt administration.

The people made it clear: we’re done. Done with the cruelty. Done with the chaos. Done with the corruption.

The people did their big one this election. Now it’s on us to end corruption, hold folks’ feet to the fire, and lower costs. 

The work continues. https://t.co/TOP5vqu501

Texas, y’all know the assignment.

Polls are open from 7 AM to 7 PM.

GO VOTE! https://t.co/m04iPpwNqs

I am heartbroken by the violence in Deep Ellum last night.

Four people lost their lives, 15 others were injured, and families across our community are waking up to unimaginable grief.

My heart is with every family impacted and everyone recovering from their injuries.

Dallas deserves better. We cannot allow gun violence to become our normal.

Todd Blanche and this corrupt administration are already planning to play games with the election.

Apparently, old habits die hard because this man is still acting like Trump’s personal attorney.

Our democracy does not belong to Trump and his sellout friends. It belongs to the https://t.co/0GcU102hHL

Thank you for reminding the world what it means to stand up for others — even when it meant standing in the fire yourself.

You’ve always believed in me and poured so much into me, even off camera. 

Today, I hope you feel all the love, receive all your flowers, and know just how https://t.co/Qx1rOCSuKt

Texas, it’s time to lock in.

Early voting starts today. Go vote! https://t.co/XtELVV5Eoa

In less than a week, Trump’s newest lying mouthpiece was fired.

She was never an attorney. She never passed the bar, and from what we’ve seen, reading seems to be a struggle for her too.

As an attorney licensed in both Arkansas and Texas, I had to earn my credentials.

The American people deserve QUALIFIED public servants. That standard should apply to everyone, including the man occupying the White House.

My heart breaks for the children, their loved ones, and the entire Bend community. I’m praying for everyone affected by this horrific tragedy.

Keeping our kids safe is our responsibility, and we cannot keep failing them. https://t.co/9kLekDPuUQ

These Air Force One memories still feel like yesterday! Wes, one thing about you, you're going to show up for people. It's in your DNA! Grateful for your friendship, your heart for service, and the fact that you mean what you say and back it up with action. Wishing you a year full of blessings and plenty to celebrate. 

Happy birthday, my friend and big brother!❤️
Hills I’ll die on as an attorney, former state representative, and Congresswoman 💅🏾🏛️✨ https://t.co/QFvJL6dwiX

This Administration cannot stand when women of color refuse to back down. 

Just weeks before the election, they’ve weaponized DHS to raid Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home.

This is authoritarian behavior — plain and simple. 

We will NOT be intimidated.

A child had to watch their father get shot by ICE.

Our babies deserve to be kids. Not live in fear. Not locked in cages. And not be caught in gunfire while in the back seat of a car.

This rogue ICE agency is out of control. Enough.

Happy 100th birthday to the dedicated, driven, and dynamic Dr. Opal Lee!

Thank you for your resilience, your strength, and for refusing to let this country ignore its history.

You’ve poured so much love into this world. May your birthday be filled with the same love and joy you’ve given so many!❤️

Donald Trump is unfit for office. Full stop.

Let’s be clear: pushing for the death of the very people you swore to protect is dangerous, reckless, and a betrayal of your oath.

The American people deserve better. https://t.co/medypJzimd

Our kids are being hogtied, handcuffed, and tased in our schools. 

Keeping them safe should be the bare minimum. 

I am urging our Texas leaders to exercise immediate oversight and ensure accountability for these horrific reported actions. This is unacceptable, and it has to stop.

Today, October 5, is the last day to register to vote for the November election!

Register and check your status at https://t.co/SdDQgf15Zy⁠

Your voice matters. Make sure it counts. https://t.co/AC6fEFxp3I

Congratulations to my dear friend @RepLaMonica! Even with so much on your shoulders, you’ve never stopped fighting for the people. 

God bless you and your beautiful family!💗 https://t.co/A4CBVsIcc0

Working families deserve more than a Band-Aid fix. They need real relief at the pump, at the grocery store, and at the doctor’s office.

Let’s run the receipts: Trump has dragged us into this illegal war, cut SNAP and Medicaid for millions of Americans, and just spent $20 million of your tax dollars on ads lying about his failed policies.

They need to stop putting on a show for the midterms and start showing up for the people.

Republicans campaigned on lowering costs, protecting democracy, and standing up for working families. Yet here they are bribing voters, closing polling sites, and kicking people off the voter rolls.

They control every lever of power in Washington, but all we’ve seen from them is lawlessness, lip service, and lies. 

If they had actually delivered on their promises, they wouldn’t be afraid of your vote.

Come through, South Dallas! 

If you need assistance with a federal agency, join Team Crockett for Mobile Office Hours on October 10 from 11:00AM–1:00PM. 

We’re bringing constituent services to you! See you there!

RSVP: https://t.co/0pU6vrQA6D https://t.co/gSLQr8PSi5
https://t.co/iavaGPYwBG

Texas mothers are dying, and instead of giving us answers, Abbott’s administration is hiding that data right before the midterms.

Texans deserve the truth. They deserve transparency. And our state officials have a legal obligation to give it to them.

I’m demanding the report be released immediately.

This is bigger than partisan politics. This is about people.

Our neighbors are being shot, our children are being kidnapped, and our communities are living in fear.

And while this administration continues to fuel the agency at the center of it all, Republicans didn’t even bother to show up.

Enough. We deserve better.

If we want a government that is by the people, for the people, and a real representation of the people, we’ve got to show up. 

Go Vote.

#NolanWells https://t.co/ec7GyBSKro

A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
